outputIntent: Create one repeatable museum-grade specimen plate that makes the individual specimen desirable, identifiable, and factually specific.
positioning: Not a general encyclopedia, ranking page, or sticker sheet; it is one plate in a coherent collection with a stable specimen identity.
contentSchema: exactly one specimen and collection ID

layoutFamilies.topology: hero specimen fills the central-left field; three asymmetric feature vignettes pin around it; collection plaque and fact strip stay secondary
layoutFamilies.readingPath: hero silhouette -> identifying features -> collection plaque -> fact
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: precise natural-history plate view with one hero scale and macro detail insets
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one hero, two to four feature vignettes, one plaque, one fact strip

layoutFamilies.topology: specimen remains dominant while a shallow archival drawer reveals one context object, two material callouts, and one lifecycle cue
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: high three-quarter museum drawer view with repeatable specimen bounding box
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one specimen, one context vignette, two callouts, one lifecycle cue, one fact

physicalVisualSystem.material: warm archival cotton paper, precise naturalist gouache and ink, restrained label plaques, subtle deckled texture, no faux antique distress
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: soft museum daylight from upper left with shallow specimen grounding and clean vignette illumination
physicalVisualSystem.color: warm paper, charcoal, muted botanical green, restrained ochre accent
physicalVisualSystem.typography: elegant museum-label hierarchy with concise Chinese identifiers and stable collection numbering

forbiddenElements: cute mascot drift in museum tone
qcAssertions: all vignettes belong to the hero specimen
specimen scale and frame can repeat across a collection
fact wording stays within supplied evidence
outer frame and content stop above the subtitle-safe band
